scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,frontend -c blue,green "npm --prefix apps/api run dev" "npm --prefix apps/frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix apps/api run build && npm --prefix apps/frontend run build
scripts.check: npm --prefix apps/api run check && npm --prefix apps/frontend run check
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e
